meta.title: A user whose team has the PR's category is shown

plan.title: Category-Matched User Appears in PR Assignment List

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the PR manager.
Stay on the Open tab where PR-1 is available.
Select one line item from the named PR-1.

args.goal: click the Assign person icon next to Upload PRs, inspect the opened Search a user list, scroll to the end, and stop with the complete user list visible

steps.note: The Assign control and complete user-list inspection have no dedicated catalog step, so perform them on the buyer screen.
Assert that the category-matched User A is present in the assignment list.
